extDescription.message: Facing an AI recruiter, your own AI avatar answers on your behalf, clearly identifying itself as an AI.

rehearsalIntro.message: Test bench: this page asks for camera and microphone, shows the received stream and reads five questions aloud.

question1.message: Can you introduce yourself in a few words?

question2.message: Why are you interested in this position?

question3.message: Tell me about a project you are particularly proud of.

question5.message: Where do you see yourself in five years?
